Nah, it’s a waste of money. We are talking about 1200$ here.
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: Sorry {f_botName}, but I don’t think it’s a good idea.
Bot: What? Why? You got the money…
You: Well, I do, but it’s still very expensive. Do you know how much food or clothes I can buy for that?
Bot: …
You: I know you wanted this for my health, but I don’t think that it’s really that necessary.
Bot: Alright… {{wi}}I understand…
